description: ABOUT US Flibco is a digital company, focusing on providing a state-of-the-art mobility service in Airport transportation. We're actively leveraging business intelligence methodologies to constantly improve customer satisfaction by dynamically enhancing our business processes, identifying new opportunities and service areas as well as increasing our level of service. Furthermore, we focus on state-of-the-art solutions for our transportation partners and suppliers. We arrange, develop, and equip our partners with continuously improved software that facilitates their daily business needs. Our common vision is to become the leading provider of smart, efficient and high-quality airport transfers, connecting passengers with all the main airport in Europe. For this reason, we are looking for a motivated team player who will contribute to making this vision come true. If this sentence “IT ALWAYS SEEMS IMPOSSIBLE UNTIL IT IS DONE” is motivating you, then you should check out this opportunity: WHAT IS OFFERED? A Modern working environment 100% support of your initiative and enthusiasm Team of like-minded people passionate about what they are doing and creating opportunity to make a difference Plenty of challenges to solve and to demonstrate your expertise Flexible working hours: it is not about the time spent at the office; it is about the results that you deliver Office on the South of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg with opportunities of business travel across Europe International team spirit About the role: We’re looking for an IT Product Manager with 5+ years of product management experience and a strong background in e-commerce to join our Engineering team. You’ll work alongside engineers, technical leads, and designers to discover, define, and deliver improvements across shopping, checkout, fulfillment, and transportation journeys. As the product specialist within Engineering, you’ll connect customer needs and business priorities with technical decisions, helping the team build solutions that deliver measurable value. What you will be working on: Product Ownership & Roadmap Own the product roadmap and backlog within the Engineering team, balancing customer value, business priorities, technical dependencies, and engineering capacity. Partner with engineering leads to assess feasibility, scope solutions, and address technical improvements that support product performance and scalability. Product Discovery & UX Research Conduct UX and market research, including customer interviews, usability studies, competitor analysis, and customer journey mapping. Lead product discovery with engineers and designers, involving them early in problem definition, opportunity assessment, and solution validation. Generate and validate product hypotheses through customer research, behavioral data, prototypes, and experiments. Experimentation, Analytics & Data Quality Collaborate with engineers to implement and evaluate A/B tests using GrowthBook, defining success metrics, guardrails, tracking requirements, and decision criteria. Analyze product performance using GA4, BigQuery, and Hotjar to identify customer friction and opportunities to improve conversion, retention, and delivery experience. Work with engineering and analytics colleagues to consolidate and standardize data sources, establish consistent metric definitions, and identify data and tracking gaps. Define and prioritize improvements to Google Tag Manager (GTM), event instrumentation, and data quality, ensuring measurement requirements are included in development work. Delivery & Iteration Translate discovery findings into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, giving engineers the context needed to make implementation decisions. Participate in engineering planning, backlog refinement, delivery reviews, and release preparation; clarify requirements and resolve product questions throughout development. Evaluate outcomes after release and use findings to guide further iterations. Stakeholder Partnership Act as the Engineering team’s product counterpart for business, operations, and customer-facing stakeholders, communicating priorities, tradeoffs, and results. We're looking for someone with: 5+ years of product management experience with digital or IT products, working closely with Engineering teams. Proven e-commerce experience across journeys such as shopping, checkout, payments, fulfillment, or delivery. Hands-on experience with UX research, product discovery, hypothesis generation, and validation. Practical experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including an understanding of statistical significance, sample size, and experiment limitations. Strong analytical skills and experience with GA4, BigQuery, and Hotjar, including SQL proficiency for product analysis. Understanding of GTM, event tracking, measurement plans, and data quality. Ability to discuss APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies with engineers and translate their implications into product decisions. Experience managing backlogs and delivering products within an Agile Engineering team. Strong communication and prioritization skills, with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes. You'll stand out if you also have: Experience with GrowthBook, our experimentation platform. Experience in transportation, logistics, last-mile delivery, or mobility products. Experience consolidating data sources, identifying measurement gaps, and improving GTM implementations. Familiarity with integrations across commerce, order management, and transportation systems. How you will work: We trust our employees and value autonomy. You will work in a collaborative, impact-driven culture where everyone’s voice is heard and ideas matter more than hierarchy. You will take ownership of your work, suggest improvements, and be encouraged to share your ideas. What success looks like: The Engineering team has clear product priorities, validated problems to solve, and measurable acceptance criteria. Discovery and experimentation inform development decisions, reliable analytics support evaluation, and released improvements produce measurable customer and business outcomes. Location This position is based at our headquarters in Luxembourg. We embrace a hybrid work model, offering flexibility between remote work and on-site collaboration. Ready to take on this challenge and have a good time doing it? Let’s make great things happen together! See you soon, Alex Flibco.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
title: IT Product Manager

description: Business Analyst (m/w/d) In dem dynamischen Operations Claims Team, das durch ein breites Aufgabenspektrum überzeugt, hast du direkten Zugang zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst deine Ideen und Vorschläge unmittelbar einbringen. Das erwartet Dich: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die fachliche Architektur sowie übergreifende Zielbilder in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und IT Du analysierst und modellierst Geschäftsprozesse, -objekte und -fähigkeiten und sorgst für eine durchgängige und konsistente Struktur Du bringst dich aktiv in Design- und Architekturentscheidungen ein – sowohl bei bestehenden Systemen als auch bei neuen Lösungen Du unterstützt Projektleiter bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller IT-Projekte Du behältst den Überblick, erkennst Herausforderungen frühzeitig und sorgst für pragmatische Lösungen Du hilfst dabei, Projekte und Anforderungen entlang strategischer KPIs und Unternehmensziele zu priorisieren In agilen Teams setzt du neue fachliche und regulatorische Anforderungen erfolgreich um und trägst damit direkt zum Unternehmenserfolg bei Das bringst Du mit: Erste Erfahrung als Business-, Fach- oder Prozessarchitekt oder im Anforderungsmanagement / in der Business Analyse – idealerweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzumfeld Grundverständnis von IT-Systemen, Softwareentwicklung oder Datenbanken sowie Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Abbildung in IT-Systemen Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf Augenhöhe abzuholen, Anforderungen zu strukturieren und Lösungen überzeugend zu präsentieren Analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise Idealerweise Erfahrung im klassischen und/oder agilen Projektmanagement Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

description: CONTEXTE ET ENJEUX Dans Le Cadre De La Transformation De Son Organisation IT, Structurée En Tribes Et Centres D’Expertise, La Banque Recherche Un Product Owner Identity Pour Rejoindre Le Centre D’Expertise Production Security. Anciennement Désigné IAM (Identity And Access Management), Identity Constitue L’un Des Piliers De La Cybersécurité De La Banque Et S’articule Autour Des Activités Suivantes IAM Services : gestion des identités, des comptes et des accès Technical IAM : accompagnement des projets IT, modélisation dans l’outil interne et gestion des évolutions Audit and Controls : contrôle des activités, respect des SLA, conformité au référentiel NIST et production des preuves d’audit PAM : administration des comptes à privilèges En tant que Product Owner Identity, vous coordonnez et pilotez l’ensemble de ces activités afin d’en garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la bonne exécution. CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ? Le ou la Product Owner est responsable du produit Identity pour les entités de BNP Paribas présentes au Luxembourg et représente les besoins de ses clients et parties prenantes. Il ou elle maximise la valeur délivrée par le produit, en tenant compte des priorités métier et de la capacité de réalisation de l’équipe. Il ou elle porte et partage la vision du produit afin de construire la roadmap des activités Identity. À ce titre, ses principales responsabilités sont les suivantes : Garantir le bon déroulement des activités récurrentes de gestion des droits d’accès logiques aux systèmes, aux applications et aux données de la Banque, afin de répondre rapidement aux demandes validées concernant ces ressources. Accompagner les équipes IT et Métiers dans leurs projets, notamment lors de la modélisation des habilitations aux systèmes, applications et ressources concernés. Accompagner les projets de transformation en y intégrant les enjeux liés à Identity. Veiller à la maîtrise des comptes à privilèges. Agir en tant que référent dans le cadre des contrôles, des audits et de l’évaluation au regard du référentiel NIST. L’ensemble de ces activités s’inscrit dans le respect des procédures de sécurité en vigueur, au service de tous les collaborateurs de la Banque. LES MISSIONS C’EST IMPORTANT, L’ÉQUIPE ET L’ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI ! Votre environnement de travail Le poste est basé au siège de BGL BNP Paribas à Luxembourg-Ville. Vous serez rattaché(e) au responsable du Centre d’Expertise Production Security. Le poste est basé au siège de BGL BNP Paribas à Luxembourg-Ville et est rattaché au responsable du Centre d’Expertise Production Security. Composée de dix personnes, l’équipe est dynamique et engagée afin d’offrir le meilleur service possible à tous les utilisateurs de la Banque. La solidarité et l’entraide permettent d’assurer la continuité du service, notamment en cas d’absence ou de pic d’activité. L’équipe Identity fournit un service central à l’échelle de la Banque. Ses interlocuteurs comprennent notamment les collaborateurs, les équipes IT, les fonctions de risques IT, les RSSI Métiers et le CISO de la Banque. Le poste est éligible au télétravail ainsi qu’au travail depuis un site distant. Aucun déplacement n’est à prévoir. Pour toute question relative au poste, vous pouvez contacter le Chapter Lead ou le Tribe Lead. Les apports de ce poste ? Le poste de Product Owner Identity offre un périmètre particulièrement diversifié. Il permet d’acquérir une vision globale du produit Identity, d’en piloter les activités au quotidien et d’accompagner ses évolutions. Il favorise également de nombreuses interactions au sein de l’IT, des Métiers et du Groupe. ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR(E) PRODUCT OWNER IDENTITY ? Expérience professionnelle et/ou diplôme Vous êtes titulaire au minimum d’un diplôme de niveau Bachelor et justifiez d’une expérience diversifiée dans le domaine informatique, comprenant une expérience en cybersécurité. Compétences comportementales Capacité à collaborer et à travailler en équipe Rigueur Capacité d’organisation Sens du service et orientation client Capacité à partager / transmettre des connaissances Créativité & Innovation / Capacité à résoudre des problèmes Compétences transversales Capacité à comprendre, expliquer et conduire le changement Capacité d’analyse Capacité à gérer un projet Compétences techniques Vous avez des compétences IT transverses et des compétences en cybersécurité notamment en Identity (IAM) Idéalement vous avez déjà une expérience sur notre outil Brat, sur les environnements BGL et groupe. Vous avez une expérience de réponse à audits et/ou NIST Vous connaissez des systèmes de gestion Identity tels que Sailpoint Identity IQ Connaissances linguistiques Vous maîtrisez le français et avez de bonnes connaissances en anglais.
title: Product Owner Identity (H/F)

description: Role Summary We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused B2B Growth Manager – SME Lending to drive acquisition, activation and growth of SME customers across the BOTIM ecosystem. The role will own the end-to-end growth funnel for SME Lending: from identifying and acquiring high-potential businesses to driving application, approval, disbursement, repeat borrowing and cross-sell. As growth manager, you will work with all other stakeholders from Product, Credit/Risk, Sales, Partnerships and Data, using BOTIM's first-party ecosystem, digital channels, partnerships and experimentation to build scalable SME lending growth engines. Responsibilities 2. Funnel Growth & Conversion 3. Data-Driven SME Targeting 4. Growth Through the BOTIM Ecosystem SME Acquisition & Lead Generation: Build and execute the growth strategy to acquire qualified SME borrowers. Identify high-potential - SME segments using BOTIM's first-party customer, merchant and transaction data. Build acquisition funnels across in-app surfaces, CRM, digital marketing, partnerships and offline channels. Develop differentiated strategies for existing BOTIM businesses versus external SME acquisition. Continuously improve lead quality and cost per qualified borrower. Own and optimize the complete SME lending funnel: Target SME → Lead → Application → Approval → Disbursement → Repeat Borrowing Identify funnel drop-offs and build experiments to improve conversion at every stage. Partner with Product and Operations to simplify application and onboarding journeys. Develop CRM journeys for incomplete applications, approved-but-not-disbursed customers, repeat borrowers and dormant SMEs. Run structured A/B tests across propositions, messaging, channels and journeys. Build SME segmentation based on company profile, industry, transaction behaviour, business size, engagement and credit eligibility. Work with Risk and Data teams to identify signals associated with high-quality borrowers. Create propensity-based targeting to prioritize businesses most likely to apply, qualify and disburse. Develop lifecycle cohorts such as high-potential, newly eligible, repeat borrowers, declining engagement and reactivation opportunities. Build cross-sell loops across BOTIM's growing B2B financial ecosystem. Identify opportunities such as: Acquiring / POS → SME Lending WPS / Payroll → SME Lending B2B Remittance → SME Lending Merchant Transactions → Pre-qualified Lending Offers Turn BOTIM's existing business relationships and transaction data into scalable acquisition and lending opportunities. 5. Partnerships & New Growth Channels Identify new distribution opportunities through merchant ecosystems, aggregators, marketplaces, PSPs and other B2B platforms. Partner with internal commercial and partnership teams to develop joint acquisition programs. Test new channels and propositions before scaling based on unit economics and portfolio quality. Requirements 5–8 years of experience in Growth, Fintech, Lending, B2B Financial Services, Payments or Digital Businesses. Strong experience building and optimizing digital acquisition and conversion funnels. Highly analytical and comfortable working with large datasets. Strong understanding of experimentation, cohort analysis and funnel optimization. Experience with SQL, BI tools, CRM platforms or product analytics is strongly preferred. Ability to translate data into clear growth opportunities and executable campaigns. Strong commercial understanding and ability to evaluate CAC, conversion, revenue and ROI. Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Risk, Credit, Data, Sales and Operations. Experience in SME lending, merchant acquiring, embedded finance or B2B fintech is a strong advantage. UAE / GCC fintech experience is preferred.
title: Growth Manager, Botim For Business
Qualified CMA – Finance, Costing & Business Analysis

description: Company Mission Payhawk is one AI-powered spend management platform for scaling businesses — corporate cards, expense management, procurement, and accounts payable, unified in one place. We serve finance teams across 32+ countries, cutting month-end close time and reconciling 99.7% of transactions with zero manual touch. AI runs through the platform as core infrastructure, not a bolted-on feature — and we hire the top 1% of talent in every function to keep building it that way. Why Payhawk Payhawk, where the bold builders make an impact. We're not a family, we're a high-performance team — and that's deliberate. We debate, ideate, and push each other to be better, because the best ideas come from direct feedback. We've already made history as Bulgaria's first unicorn, but the ambition doesn't stop there: if you want to grow fast - own it; do not wait for it. Give : Honest opinions, real ownership, a focus on outcomes. Get : A front-row seat to a market leader in one of the fastest-moving industries. The role, in one line You will own demand generation for your region(s). You will set the pipeline plan against the regional sales target, decide which product lines to push locally and when, and brief the marketing shared services that help you deliver it. What you will own Regional strategy and planning Define the demand-generation and channel strategy for your region(s), across New Business and Expansion motions and across channels. Brief marketing shared services (Paid, SEO, Lifecycle, Content, Events) through a rolling campaign brief. Represent your region(s) in the quarterly regional planning cycle and the weekly marketing meetings. Prioritise initiatives ruthlessly based on go-to-market strategy, so the regional team is not spread too thin. Own the relationship with the regional sales team. Regional operating cadence and reporting Lead the monthly regional review report. Report outcomes and insights, not just activities, and set out your regional priorities and strategy so leadership stays aligned. Justify spending decisions and marketing ROI. Bring a passionate, positive attitude that carries through the regional commercial team. Budget Own the regional campaign budget. Decide how to split it across demand-generation and demand-capture channels and initiatives to get the most cost-efficiency and marketing ROI. Campaign execution Work with the ABM lead so regional campaigns and named-account plays share campaign structure, hypotheses, personas and targeting, in line with the Named Accounts structure in the Revenue Org. Build and maintain the framework and rules for how accounts move through the account funnel stages. Launch campaigns fast, test relentlessly, and refine them based on real-world feedback. Develop key campaign assets (ads, emails, landing pages), and partner with the Content team on localisation. Orchestrate multi-touch, multi-channel campaigns, including digital ads, outbound email and gifting. Plan regional co-marketing with the Partner Marketing lead, and align regional nurture and customer programmes with Lifecycle. Track and analyse campaign effectiveness with Marketing Operations, and find opportunities to optimise. Sales alignment Work closely with the BDR team so ABM signals inform outreach and drive conversion. Work closely with the AE team so MQLs are worked promptly and expertly, and we win the pipeline we create. AI adoption Lead AI adoption and use it to transform how this role works. For example: Cut campaign build time so ads, emails and landing pages go from brief to live in hours, not weeks. Personalise one-to-many at named-account scale, which used to need a much larger team. Use AI that monitors and optimises live campaigns, adjusting targeting, spend and creative in real time. How you will be measured Northstar metric Pipeline generated in your region(s) against the regional sales target, across new business and expansion. Additional Outcomes You Will Drive MRR won in your region. MRR and number of won Named Accounts in your region. Pipeline from Named Accounts in your region, in step with the ABM lead. A consistent monthly flow of “Engaged” Named Accounts. Higher Engaged-to-SAL conversion rates, through highly relevant campaign motions. Pipeline generated at a strong return per euro spent, with spending decisions you can justify. What you will need Must-have 5+ years of demand-generation experience. Native-level French, German, Dutch, Swedish or Polish. Fluent English. Proven experience building marketing strategies that support an outbound motion. A proven track record of generating demand with Enterprise accounts. Experience building programmatic marketing campaigns. A growth mindset: you have run high volumes of structured experiments to improve marketing effectiveness. A hands-on approach. You will set strategy, and you will also write copy, build landing pages and test new tools yourself. Strong leadership skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Willingness to work from one of Payhawk’s UK or European offices. Nice-to-have Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech. What You Will Get Recharge properly — 30 days of paid holiday Change the view — a week-long exchange to London, Amsterdam, Paris, Munich, Vilnius, Berlin, Sofia, or Barcelona Win together, celebrate together — regular team-wide events that are actually worth showing up to Covered, properly — additional medical care Stay in the game — a sports card, fully funded, for the gym, classes, or your sport of choice Commute easily — a monthly travel allowance that covers getting to and from the office Use what you build — hands-on access to the actual product you're hiring people to help build Payhawk is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
